results.title: Researchers Find New Yellow-Snouted Venomous Snake in Laos’ Vang Vieng
results.content: Researchers have found a new kind of venomous snake living in caves in Vang Vieng, Vientiane Province. The snake has a bright yellow-orange snout. The study, published in the journal Herpetozoa, describes the species from one adult female collected near Khan Kham Cave in October 2024.
